rules.rule: Never use localStorage or sessionStorage. All persistent client state must go through IndexedDBService; small user settings go through the platform storage seam (getPlatform().storage, src/platform/types.ts), never a host API called directly.
No proxy/re-export barrel files. Import directly from the implementation file, never from an index/barrel that only re-exports.
Never fetch data in a useEffect. Data fetching belongs in services or the Zustand store; components read from the store synchronously.
No custom CSS. Use DaisyUI semantic classes (e.g. btn-primary, bg-base-200) and Tailwind utilities only.
All application state lives in Zustand slices (src/store/slices/create*Slice.ts). No ad-hoc/generic global state outside the sliced store.
Files should stay under ~200 lines. Flag files that grow well past this and suggest splitting.

IS Mendelu HTML parsers are extremely brittle and must almost never change. Never alter a parser to fix a lint or test error (suppress the lint / fix the test fixture instead). Column-index constants are load-bearing. Any parser change requires a real IS Mendelu HTML sample as evidence, otherwise it must be reverted.

reIS transmits nothing about a failure on its own: no error-reporting service, no background collection. Route non-fatal errors through logError (src/utils/reportError.ts), which only logs locally and keeps a cleaned copy in the in-memory diagnostic log. Flag any reintroduction of sendTelemetry, initTelemetry, report_error or report_error_v2, any new file that talks to Supabase without being added to SUPABASE_CALLERS in src/test/guards/noStudentDataLeaves.test.ts, and any imports added to src/utils/diagnostics/diagnosticLog.ts (it must import nothing). A change to what reIS sends must update privacy/disclosures.ts in the same PR.

In the browser extension, host integration is push-based: data flows content script -> iframe, never the reverse. The iframe app must never call IS Mendelu directly; only the content script fetches host data. (The Capacitor iOS/Android apps have no content script and call IS Mendelu through src/platform/ — this rule does not apply to them.)

The app language code is 'cz'/'en' everywhere (Language in src/store/types.ts), the same values IS Mendelu's lang= takes, so store values pass to the API layer unmapped. Flag any cs->cz mapping added at a store or API call site. 'cs' is only a BCP-47 locale: it may appear only where a value is handed to Intl/toLocaleDateString or names a locale file, converted at that boundary (language === 'cz' ? 'cs' : language).
The extension manifest is generated from wxt.config.ts and must never be hand-edited.
